title: Japanese chicken curry with carrots and potatoes
steps: Wash the rice and cook it with 160 ml water for 12 minutes.
Slice the onion, cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and dice the chicken.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, briefly fry the chicken, dust with the flour and curry powder and toast for 1 minute.
Add the stock, vegetables and grated apple and simmer for 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Season with soy sauce, honey and salt and serve with rice.
